question: The autobiography titled _________by Anne Frank describes a thirteen - year - old Jewish girl’s experiences during World War II.

options.text: The Diary of A Young Girl
True Love and a Little Malice
I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Diary of A Young Girl.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**__

__
 
• **The Diary of a Young Girl, **also popular as** The Diary of Anne Frank**, journal by Anne Frank, a Jewish teenager who recorded her family's **two years (1942–44)** in hiding in the time of a **German job in the Netherlands during World War II.**
 
• The Diary of a Young Girl is a book of **writings from the Dutch-language diary** retained by Anne Frank.
 
• In the time of a Nazi job of the Netherlands, Anne Frank accepted a blank diary as one of her gifts on **12 June 1942, her 13th birthday.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **My Country My Life** is an autobiography written by** L. K. Advani, an Indian politician** who worked as the Deputy Prime Minister of India from** 2002 to 2004** and was the head of the Opposition in the **15th Lok Sabha.​ **
 
• **Truth, Love and a Little Malice **is the name of the **autobiography of Khushwant Singh**, a famous Indian author.
 
• **I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings**, the first of seven autobiographical serves by American author **Maya Angelou, published in 1969.**
